P064.title: An improved method for slab track-soil interaction considering soil surface deformation
P064.authors: Z Li, L Xu, X Deng
P064.journal_citation: Mechanics based design of structures and machines 52 (7), 4260-4283
P064.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: In this work, the finite element modeling and numerical iterative method are presented to compile a simulation program to reveal the deformation coordinated process of slab track-soil interaction reasonably, where the contact-separation relationship at the slab track-soil interface, the interlayered gap between slab track and soil surface, and additional track deformation are derived as additional geometric excitations of VTS interaction system.

The deformation coordinated process of track-soil interaction is regarded as the geometric excitations to dynamic analysis, classified as three aspects: (I) contact-separation relationship of track-soil interface; (II) interlayered gap between track and soil surface; (III) additional track deformation.
